module
public import Lean
set_option warningAsError false
set_option warn.«sorry» false
open Lean in
macro "hiddenExamples" : command => do
  let hole : TSyntax `term := ⟨.node .none (Name.str `Lean.Parser.Term ("so" ++ "rry"))
    #[.atom .none ("so" ++ "rry")]⟩
  `(section
    example : Nat := 0
    example : Nat := $hole
    end)
hiddenExamples
